t: AI on Rails: Desert Kite Method for Efficient AI Collaboration
s: The 'AI on Rails' method, drawing on 'Desert Kites' and Nix, champions declarative AI context engineering by human 'Content Architects' for efficiency. Illustrated by Gemini AI performing targeted Python code edits and resolving path issues.
sub: AI on Rails: Declarative context engineering (Desert Kite analogy)
Nix/Guix for deterministic, efficient AI interaction
Gemini AI for targeted Python code modification & path issue troubleshooting
